input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, my access denied handler, link imp. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include content management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with custom error functionality, so that I can accomplish my custom error-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with home functionality, so that I can accomplish my home-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with link functionality, so that I can accomplish my link-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with links functionality, so that I can accomplish my links-related tasks.
